title: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz Vows to Stay in Power After Election Defeats
subtitle: Despite poor results in two state elections, the leader of Germany insists he will continue his economic reform plans.

summary.en: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz is facing a serious political crisis following poor results for his party in two state elections. In Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, his party failed to reach the threshold required to enter the local parliament. Meanwhile, in Berlin, his party finished behind the far-left Die Linke. Despite these losses and calls for his resignation, Merz has stated he will remain in office. He believes his planned economic reforms are necessary to protect the country from political extremism.
summary.zh: 德國總理梅爾茲在兩場邦議會選舉中表現不佳，正面臨嚴重的政治危機。在梅克倫堡-西波美拉尼亞邦，他的政黨未能達到進入地方議會的門檻；而在柏林，該黨的得票則落後於極左翼的左派黨。儘管面臨這些挫敗與辭職呼聲，梅爾茲已表示將留任。他認為自己規劃的經濟改革對於保護國家免受政治極端主義侵害是必要的。

paragraphs.en: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz is facing a difficult political future after his party, the Christian Democratic Union (CDU), suffered major losses in two state elections held on Sunday. These results follow a series of recent electoral defeats, creating a sense of instability in Europe’s largest economy. Despite the pressure, Merz has declared that he will not resign and will continue to lead the country.
paragraphs.zh: 德國總理梅爾茲（Friedrich Merz）正面臨艱困的政治前途，因為他的所屬政黨基督教民主黨（CDU）在週日舉行的兩場邦議會選舉中慘敗。這些選舉結果延續了近期一連串的挫敗，為這個歐洲最大經濟體帶來了不穩定感。儘管壓力沉重，梅爾茲已宣告他不會辭職，並將繼續領導國家。

paragraphs.en: In the north-eastern state of Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, the CDU received less than 5% of the vote. This is the minimum amount required to enter the state parliament, meaning the party may be excluded from the government entirely. According to BBC News, Merz described this result as a “disaster” for his party. Meanwhile, the far-right Alternative for Germany (AfD) party performed strongly, winning the most votes in the region. However, other major parties have refused to work with the AfD, creating a "firewall"—a firm agreement to avoid any cooperation—that will likely keep the far-right group out of power.
paragraphs.zh: 在東北部的梅克倫堡-西波美拉尼亞邦，基督教民主黨的得票率不到百分之五。這是進入邦議會的最低門檻，意味著該黨可能完全被排除在政府之外。根據英國廣播公司新聞（BBC News）報導，梅爾茲形容此結果對他的政黨而言是一場「災難」。與此同時，極右翼的德國另類選擇黨（AfD）表現強勁，贏得了該地區最多的選票。然而，其他主要政黨已拒絕與德國另類選擇黨合作，形成了一道「防火牆」——即避免任何合作的堅定協議——這很可能會將該極右翼團體阻擋在權力核心之外。

paragraphs.en: In the capital, Berlin, the situation was also challenging for the Chancellor. The CDU finished behind the far-left party Die Linke, which is now expected to lead the city government. Deutsche Welle reports that the CDU’s support in Berlin dropped significantly, falling to about 20%. This result marks the third time in just two weeks that the CDU has faced a significant electoral setback, following a major loss in the state of Saxony-Anhalt earlier in September.
paragraphs.zh: 在首都柏林，總理的處境同樣嚴峻。基督教民主黨的得票落後於極左翼的左派黨（Die Linke），後者預計將主導市政府。德國之聲（Deutsche Welle）報導指出，基督教民主黨在柏林的支持率大幅下滑，跌至約百分之二十。這是基督教民主黨在短短兩週內第三次面臨重大的選舉挫敗，此前九月初在薩克森-安哈特邦也遭遇了慘重損失。

paragraphs.en: These election results reflect growing public unhappiness with the national government. Chancellor Merz currently leads a coalition—a government formed by two or more parties working together—with the Social Democratic Party (SPD). However, recent polls suggest that this coalition no longer has the support of the majority of the German population. Many voters are concerned about the country’s economic situation, which includes slow growth, high energy costs, and the loss of industrial strength.
paragraphs.zh: 這些選舉結果反映出大眾對國家政府日益不滿。梅爾茲總理目前與社會民主黨（SPD）組成聯合政府——即由兩個或多個政黨共同執政的政府。然而，近期民調顯示，這個執政聯盟已不再獲得多數德國民眾的支持。許多選民對國家的經濟狀況感到擔憂，包括成長緩慢、能源成本高昂以及工業實力流失等問題。

paragraphs.en: Despite the mounting pressure, Merz remains firm in his decision to stay in office. Speaking at his party’s headquarters in Berlin, he argued that his government must continue with its plans for economic, tax, and welfare reforms. According to The Guardian, Merz stated that these changes are essential for the country’s future. He described his reform agenda as an “antidote” to the “poison of authoritarianism,” suggesting that strong leadership is needed to stop radical political groups from gaining more influence in society.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管壓力與日俱增，梅爾茲仍堅定留任的決定。他在柏林的黨部發表演說時主張，政府必須繼續推動經濟、稅務及福利改革計畫。根據衛報（The Guardian）報導，梅爾茲表示這些變革對國家的未來至關重要。他將自己的改革議程形容為對抗「威權主義毒素」的「解藥」，暗示需要強而有力的領導，才能阻止激進政治團體在社會中擴大影響力。

paragraphs.en: Some political figures have already begun to call for change. The AfD co-leader, Tino Chrupalla, publicly mocked the Chancellor after the results were announced, suggesting that it is time for Merz to step down. There has also been intense speculation about whether Merz could be replaced by his own party before his term ends. However, the German constitution makes it difficult to remove a chancellor against their will, and Merz has received support from the leaders of several German states who want him to continue his work.
paragraphs.zh: 部分政治人物已開始呼籲變革。德國另類選擇黨的共同領袖克魯帕拉（Tino Chrupalla）在選舉結果公布後公開嘲諷總理，暗示梅爾茲是時候下台了。外界也出現了強烈的揣測，討論梅爾茲是否會在任期結束前被黨內撤換。然而，德國憲法規定要違背總理意願將其罷免相當困難，且梅爾茲已獲得多位希望他繼續推動工作的德國邦首長支持。

paragraphs.en: As the country looks ahead, the political landscape remains uncertain. The rise of parties like the AfD and Die Linke shows that voters are looking for alternatives to the traditional parties that have held power for years. For now, Merz is focusing on his goal of moving Germany forward, despite the “harsh” and “irreconcilable” nature of current public debates. He has asked for “backbone, steadfastness and patience” as he attempts to guide the country through these turbulent times.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，德國的政治版圖依然充滿不確定性。德國另類選擇黨與左派黨的崛起顯示，選民正在尋求傳統執政黨以外的替代選擇。目前，儘管公眾辯論呈現「尖銳」且「不可調和」的狀態，梅爾茲仍專注於推動德國前進的目標。他呼籲大眾展現「骨氣、堅定與耐心」，以協助他帶領國家度過這些動盪時期。

paragraphs.en: Whether Merz can regain the trust of the public remains to be seen. With national elections approaching in 2029, the Chancellor is under pressure to prove that his economic policies can deliver results. For the moment, he is determined to remain in his position, insisting that he is the right person to lead Germany through its current period of profound change.
paragraphs.zh: 梅爾茲能否重拾公眾信任仍有待觀察。隨著二零二九年全國大選逼近，總理面臨著證明其經濟政策能帶來成效的壓力。目前，他決心堅守職位，堅持自己是帶領德國度過當前深刻變革時期的最佳人選。

keyTerms.definitionEn: A strong, protective barrier or agreement designed to prevent something (like a political group) from spreading or gaining power.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 防火牆；在此比喻為防止特定政黨取得權力的堅定協議。
keyTerms.noteZh: 通常指電腦網路安全，這裡比喻政治上的隔絕手段。文中：However, other major parties have refused to work with the AfD, creating a "firewall"—a firm agreement to avoid any cooperation—that will likely keep the far-right group out of power.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To resign or leave a position of authority.
keyTerms.noteZh: 由動詞 step 和副詞 down 組成，意思與字面拆解不同。文中：The AfD co-leader, Tino Chrupalla, publicly mocked the Chancellor after the results were announced, suggesting that it is time for Merz to step down.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Strength of character, courage, or determination.
keyTerms.noteZh: 原意為脊椎，這裡指人的堅毅性格。文中：He has asked for “backbone, steadfastness and patience” as he attempts to guide the country through these turbulent times.

quiz.question: What is the specific consequence of the CDU's performance in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania?

options.A: The party is now required to form a coalition with the AfD.
options.B: The party faces the possibility of being completely excluded from the state parliament.
options.C: The party has officially resigned from the national government.
options.D: The party won the most votes but was blocked by a firewall.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第二段，CDU 在 Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania 獲得不到 5% 的選票，而這是進入州議會的最低門檻，因此該黨可能完全被排除在政府之外。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章提到其他政黨拒絕與 AfD 合作，並未提及 CDU 與其結盟。選項 C 錯誤，因為 Merz 已明確表示不會辭職。選項 D 錯誤，因為文章指出是 AfD 贏得了多數票，而非 CDU。

quiz.question: Based on the article, why is it unlikely that the AfD will gain power in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania despite their strong performance?

options.A: The German constitution forbids far-right parties from holding office.
options.B: The AfD lacks the necessary economic reforms to govern effectively.
options.C: Other established political parties have agreed not to form any alliances with them.
options.D: The public is unhappy with all political parties, including the AfD.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第二段，其他主要政黨建立了一個「防火牆」（firewall），即達成堅定的協議避免與 AfD 合作，這使得該黨難以進入權力核心。選項 A 錯誤，文章並未提及憲法禁止極右派執政。選項 B 錯誤，文章未討論 AfD 的改革能力。選項 D 雖然提到民眾不滿，但並非 AfD 無法取得權力的直接原因，關鍵在於其他政黨的排擠策略。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does Chancellor Merz mean when he describes his reform agenda as an 'antidote'?

options.A: A solution intended to counteract a harmful situation.
options.B: A medical treatment for a physical illness.
options.C: A secret plan to destroy political opponents.
options.D: A temporary measure to delay economic collapse.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。在文章第五段中，Merz 將改革議程稱為「antidote」（解藥），用來對抗「authoritarianism」（威權主義）的「poison」（毒藥），意指他的政策是用來解決或抵銷當前政治威脅的手段。選項 B 是字面意思，但在文中是隱喻用法。選項 C 錯誤，這不是為了摧毀對手，而是為了防止極端勢力影響力擴大。選項 D 錯誤，文章並未將其描述為僅是延遲崩潰的臨時措施。

quiz.question: What is the central theme of the article regarding Chancellor Friedrich Merz?

options.A: The successful implementation of new economic policies in Germany.
options.B: The inevitable collapse of the German coalition government.
options.C: The challenges Merz faces as he struggles to maintain his leadership amidst political instability.
options.D: The historical rise of the AfD and Die Linke in German state politics.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。整篇文章圍繞著 Merz 在選舉失利後的困境、他面臨的壓力、他對改革的堅持以及他試圖穩固領導地位的過程。選項 A 錯誤，因為文章重點在於他的政策尚未顯現成果且面臨質疑。選項 B 錯誤，雖然 coalition 處於壓力下，但文章並未斷言其必然崩潰。選項 D 雖然是背景資訊，但文章的核心焦點是 Merz 的政治命運與應對方式，而非僅僅是其他政黨的興起。
